# Setup

```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(ggridges)
library(ggalluvial)
library(forcats)
library(HDAnalyzeR)
library(ggConvexHull)
library(UpSetR)
library(readxl)
library(pheatmap)

# Specify function
select <- dplyr::select
filter <- dplyr::filter
mutate <- dplyr::mutate
rename <- dplyr::rename

# Set ggplot2 defaults
ggplot2::update_geom_defaults(
  "point",
  list(size = 2, alpha = 0.6)
)

# Source scripts
source("../scripts/functions/themes_palettes.R")

# Read data
metadata <- read_csv("../data/curated/metadata.csv")
data_long <- read_csv("../data/curated/data_long.csv")
data_wide <- read_csv("../data/curated/data_wide.csv")
data_long_ml <- read_csv("../data/curated/data_long_ml.csv")
data_wide_ml <- read_csv("../data/curated/data_wide_ml.csv")

single_cell_cluster_data_raw <- read_tsv("../data/HPA/rna_single_cell_cluster.tsv")
hpa_data <- read_tsv("../data/HPA/proteinatlas_2ba9716c.tsv")
olink_uniprot_raw <- read_excel("../data/HPA/assay_list.xlsx", skip = 1)

olink_uniprot <- olink_uniprot_raw |>
  select(UniProt = `Uniprot ID`, Feature = `Gene name`)
olink_uniprot
```

```{r}
metadata |>
  filter(Disease == "HIV") |>
  group_by(`Immune responder (CD4/CD8)`, Timepoint) |>
  summarize(n = n()) 
```





```{r}
data_wide |>
  # Count the number of NAs per Feature
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -DAid,
    names_to = "Feature",
    values_to = "NPX"
  ) |>
  group_by(Feature) |>
  summarise(
    n_missing = sum(is.na(NPX)),
    n_total = n(),
    prop_missing = n_missing / n_total
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(prop_missing)) |>
  filter(Feature == "MFAP5")
```

# Figure 8

## Figure 8A

```{r}
input_metadata <- metadata |>
  filter(Timepoint == "Baseline",
         Subgroup != "Elite controller",
         Disease == "HIV") |>
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID)) |>
  mutate(
    Comparison = case_when(
      `CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)` < 0.5 &
      `CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)` < 0.5 ~ "case",

      `CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)` >= 1 &
      `CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)` >= 1 ~ "control",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(Comparison)) |>
  mutate(Age = ifelse(is.na(Age), `Age (baseline)`, Age)) 

input_data <- data_wide |>
  filter(DAid %in% input_metadata$DAid)

table(input_metadata$Comparison)

input_metadata |>
  count(Comparison) |>
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))

hd_obj <- HDAnalyzeR::hd_initialize(dat = input_data, 
                        metadata = input_metadata, 
                        is_wide = TRUE, 
                        sample_id = "DAid",
                        var_name = "Feature",
                        value_name = "NPX")

de_results <- hd_de_limma(dat = hd_obj,
                          variable = "Comparison", 
                          case = "case", 
                          control = c("control"), 
                          correct = c("Age", "Sex")) |> 
  hd_plot_volcano(pval_lim = 0.05,
                  logfc_lim = 0.5,
                  top_up_prot = 20,
                  top_down_prot = 20,
                  title = "Immune non-responders vs responders (at baseline)",
                  report_nproteins = FALSE,
                  user_defined_proteins = NULL)

head(de_results$de_res)

res_cd4cd8_baseline_immune_responders <- de_results$de_res

p <- de_results$volcano_plot +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "significant down" = "#317EC2",
      "significant up"   = "#C03830",
      "not significant"  = "#C4C4C4"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "significant down" = "Significantly decreased",
      "significant up"   = "Significantly increased",
      "not significant"  = "Not significant"
    ),
    name = NULL   # removes legend title ("Significance")
  )

p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$size   <- 3
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$alpha  <- 0.7
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$stroke <- 0

p

p_volcano_immune_responder_baseline <- p

ggsave(
  filename = "Volcano plot immune responder baseline.pdf",
  path     = "../plots/pdf/volcano/",
  width    = 10,
  height   = 7)

ggsave(
  filename = "Volcano plot immune responder baseline.png",
  path     = "../plots/png/volcano/",
  width    = 10,
  height   = 7)
```

```{r}
res_cd4cd8_fu_immune_responders |>
```

## Figure 8E & Figure 8G

```{r}
# ---------------------------
# 5) Feature × Cluster matrix (nCPM)
#    - average if multiple genes map to same Feature/Cluster
# ---------------------------
mat_vasculature <- cluster_df_vasculature |>
  select(Feature, `Cell type`, nCPM) |>
  group_by(Feature, `Cell type`) |>
  summarise(
    nCPM = mean(nCPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = `Cell type`,
    values_from = nCPM,
    values_fill = 0
  ) |>
  column_to_rownames("Feature") |>
  as.matrix()

# ---------------------------
# 6) Optional: log-scale (recommended)
# ---------------------------
mat_vasculature_log <- log1p(mat_vasculature)

# ---------------------------
# 7) Plot pheatmap
# ---------------------------

pdf("../plots/pdf/cluster/single_cell_vasculature_heatmap_nCPM_log1p_rowscaled.pdf",
    width = 10, height = 12
)

pheatmap(
  mat_vasculature_log,
  cluster_rows    = TRUE,
  cluster_cols    = TRUE,
  scale           = "row",     # relative expression per protein
  show_rownames   = TRUE,
  show_colnames   = TRUE,
  fontsize_row    = 9,
  fontsize_col    = 9,
  color           = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(100),
  main            = "Vasculature single-cell expression\n(nCPM, log1p, row-scaled)"
)

dev.off()
```

```{r}
targets <- res_cd4cd8_baseline_immune_responders |>
  filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05) |>
  pull(Feature)

combined_df <- hpa_data |>
  select(Ensembl, UniProt = Uniprot) |>
  inner_join(olink_uniprot, by = "UniProt") |>
  filter(Feature %in% targets)

vasculature_clusters <- single_cell_cluster_data_raw |>
  filter(Tissue == "vasculature") |>
  rename(Ensembl = Gene)

cluster_df_vasculature <- vasculature_clusters |>
  inner_join(combined_df, by = "Ensembl")

up_features <- res_cd4cd8_baseline_immune_responders |>
  filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05, logFC > 0) |>
  pull(Feature)

down_features <- res_cd4cd8_baseline_immune_responders |>
  filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05, logFC < 0) |>
  pull(Feature)

mat_up <- mat_vasculature_log[rownames(mat_vasculature_log) %in% up_features, , drop = FALSE]

mat_down <- mat_vasculature_log[rownames(mat_vasculature_log) %in% down_features, , drop = FALSE]

mat_up   <- mat_up[apply(mat_up,   1, sd) > 0, ]

row_sd <- apply(mat_down, 1, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE))

mat_down <- mat_down[row_sd > 1e-6, , drop = FALSE]

pdf(
  "../plots/pdf/cluster/single_cell_vasculature_heatmap_nCPM_log1p_rowscaled_split.pdf",
  width = 10,
  height = 10
)

pheatmap(
  mat_up,
  cluster_rows  = TRUE,
  cluster_cols  = TRUE,
  scale         = "row",
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  fontsize_row  = 8,
  fontsize_col  = 8,
  color         = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(100),
  main          = ""
)

dev.off()

if (nrow(mat_down) >= 2) {

  pdf(
    "../plots/pdf/cluster/single_cell_vasculature_heatmap_nCPM_log1p_rowscaled_downregulated.pdf",
    width = 10,
    height = 6
  )

  pheatmap(
    mat_down,
    cluster_rows  = TRUE,
    cluster_cols  = TRUE,
    scale         = "row",
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    show_colnames = TRUE,
    fontsize_row  = 8,
    fontsize_col  = 8,
    color         = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(100),
    main          = ""
  )

  dev.off()

} else {
  message(
    "Down-regulated immune responder proteins show no variable expression ",
    "across vasculature single-cell clusters (SD ≈ 0)."
  )
}
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------

# ---------------------------
```

# Supplementary Figure 16

# PCA

## CD4/CD8

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(HDAnalyzeR)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Prepare metadata
# --------------------------------------------------

pca_metadata <- metadata |>
  filter(
    Disease == "Healthy" |
      (!is.na(`Immune responder (CD4/CD8)`) & Disease == "HIV")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    ID = as.character(ID),
    PCA_group = case_when(
      Disease == "Healthy" ~ "Healthy",

      `Immune responder (CD4/CD8)` == "Immune responder" &
        Timepoint == "Baseline" ~ "Immune responders (baseline)",

      `Immune responder (CD4/CD8)` == "Immune responder" &
        Timepoint == "Follow-up" ~ "Immune responders (follow-up)",

      `Immune responder (CD4/CD8)` == "Immune non-responder" &
        Timepoint == "Baseline" ~ "Non-responders (baseline)",

      `Immune responder (CD4/CD8)` == "Immune non-responder" &
        Timepoint == "Follow-up" ~ "Non-responders (follow-up)",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(PCA_group))

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Run PCA once
# --------------------------------------------------

input_df <- data_wide_ml |>
  filter(DAid %in% pca_metadata$DAid)

pca_df <- hd_pca(
  dat = input_df,
  components = 10,
  by_sample = TRUE,
  impute = TRUE,
  seed = 123
)

pc1 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[1]
pc2 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[2]

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Join PCA + metadata
# --------------------------------------------------

pca_plot_df <- pca_df$pca_res |>
  inner_join(pca_metadata, by = "DAid") |>
  mutate(
    ID = as.character(ID),
    PCA_panel = case_when(
      PCA_group %in% c(
        "Immune responders (baseline)",
        "Immune responders (follow-up)"
      ) ~ "Immune responders",

      PCA_group %in% c(
        "Non-responders (baseline)",
        "Non-responders (follow-up)"
      ) ~ "Immune non-responders",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Duplicate healthy samples into both facets
#    Avoid crossing() conflict by using bind_rows()
# --------------------------------------------------

healthy_base <- pca_plot_df |>
  filter(PCA_group == "Healthy") |>
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID)) |>
  select(-PCA_panel)

healthy_df <- bind_rows(
  healthy_base |>
    mutate(PCA_panel = "Immune responders"),

  healthy_base |>
    mutate(PCA_panel = "Immune non-responders")
)

hiv_df <- pca_plot_df |>
  filter(PCA_group != "Healthy") |>
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID))

pca_facet_df <- bind_rows(hiv_df, healthy_df) |>
  mutate(
    ID = as.character(ID),

    PCA_panel = factor(
      PCA_panel,
      levels = c("Immune responders", "Immune non-responders")
    ),

    PCA_group = factor(
      PCA_group,
      levels = c(
        "Healthy",
        "Immune responders (baseline)",
        "Immune responders (follow-up)",
        "Non-responders (baseline)",
        "Non-responders (follow-up)"
      )
    ),

    Timepoint = case_when(
      Disease == "Healthy" ~ "Healthy",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Timepoint)
    ),

    Timepoint = factor(
      Timepoint,
      levels = c("Baseline", "Follow-up", "Healthy")
    )
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Colors
# --------------------------------------------------

pca_colors <- c(
  "Healthy" = "#BDBDBD",
  "Immune responders (baseline)" = "#4B988F",
  "Immune responders (follow-up)" = "#5A588B",
  "Non-responders (baseline)" = "#C89A1B",
  "Non-responders (follow-up)" = "#EABBBB"
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 6. Ellipse data
# --------------------------------------------------

ellipse_df <- pca_facet_df |>
  group_by(PCA_panel, PCA_group) |>
  filter(n() >= 3) |>
  ungroup()

# --------------------------------------------------
# 7. Plot
# --------------------------------------------------

p_pca_facet <- ggplot(
  pca_facet_df,
  aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = PCA_group, shape = Timepoint)
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = pca_facet_df |> filter(Disease == "HIV"),
    aes(group = ID),
    color = "grey80",
    alpha = 0.5,
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  stat_ellipse(
    data = ellipse_df,
    aes(group = PCA_group),
    type = "norm",
    level = 0.95,
    linewidth = 0.9,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  facet_wrap(~ PCA_panel, nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pca_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of immune responders and non-responders",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pc1, 2), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pc2, 2), "%)"),
    color = NULL,
    shape = NULL
  ) +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p_pca_facet

# --------------------------------------------------
# 8. Save
# --------------------------------------------------

dir.create("../plots/pdf/pca", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("../plots/png/pca", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  "../plots/pdf/pca/PCA_immune_responders_nonresponders_faceted_ellipses.pdf",
  p_pca_facet,
  width = 14,
  height = 6
)

ggsave(
  "../plots/png/pca/PCA_immune_responders_nonresponders_faceted_ellipses.png",
  p_pca_facet,
  width = 14,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

## CD4

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(HDAnalyzeR)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Prepare metadata using Immune responder (CD4)
# --------------------------------------------------

pca_metadata <- metadata |>
  filter(
    Disease == "Healthy" |
      (!is.na(`Immune responder (CD4)`) & Disease == "HIV")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    ID = as.character(ID),
    PCA_group = case_when(
      Disease == "Healthy" ~ "Healthy",

      `Immune responder (CD4)` == "Immune responder" &
        Timepoint == "Baseline" ~ "Immune responders (baseline)",

      `Immune responder (CD4)` == "Immune responder" &
        Timepoint == "Follow-up" ~ "Immune responders (follow-up)",

      `Immune responder (CD4)` == "Immune non-responder" &
        Timepoint == "Baseline" ~ "Non-responders (baseline)",

      `Immune responder (CD4)` == "Immune non-responder" &
        Timepoint == "Follow-up" ~ "Non-responders (follow-up)",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(PCA_group))

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Run PCA once
# --------------------------------------------------

input_df <- data_wide_ml |>
  filter(DAid %in% pca_metadata$DAid)

pca_df <- hd_pca(
  dat = input_df,
  components = 10,
  by_sample = TRUE,
  impute = TRUE,
  seed = 123
)

pc1 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[1]
pc2 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[2]

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Join PCA + metadata
# --------------------------------------------------

pca_plot_df <- pca_df$pca_res |>
  inner_join(pca_metadata, by = "DAid") |>
  mutate(
    ID = as.character(ID),
    PCA_panel = case_when(
      PCA_group %in% c(
        "Immune responders (baseline)",
        "Immune responders (follow-up)"
      ) ~ "Immune responders",

      PCA_group %in% c(
        "Non-responders (baseline)",
        "Non-responders (follow-up)"
      ) ~ "Immune non-responders",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Duplicate healthy samples into both facets
# --------------------------------------------------

healthy_base <- pca_plot_df |>
  filter(PCA_group == "Healthy") |>
  select(-PCA_panel)

healthy_df <- bind_rows(
  healthy_base |> mutate(PCA_panel = "Immune responders"),
  healthy_base |> mutate(PCA_panel = "Immune non-responders")
)

hiv_df <- pca_plot_df |>
  filter(PCA_group != "Healthy")

pca_facet_df <- bind_rows(hiv_df, healthy_df) |>
  mutate(
    ID = as.character(ID),

    PCA_panel = factor(
      PCA_panel,
      levels = c("Immune responders", "Immune non-responders")
    ),

    PCA_group = factor(
      PCA_group,
      levels = c(
        "Healthy",
        "Immune responders (baseline)",
        "Immune responders (follow-up)",
        "Non-responders (baseline)",
        "Non-responders (follow-up)"
      )
    ),

    Timepoint = case_when(
      Disease == "Healthy" ~ "Healthy",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Timepoint)
    ),

    Timepoint = factor(
      Timepoint,
      levels = c("Baseline", "Follow-up", "Healthy")
    )
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Colors
# --------------------------------------------------

pca_colors <- c(
  "Healthy" = "#BDBDBD",
  "Immune responders (baseline)" = "#4B988F",
  "Immune responders (follow-up)" = "#5A588B",
  "Non-responders (baseline)" = "#C89A1B",
  "Non-responders (follow-up)" = "#EABBBB"
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 6. Ellipse data
# --------------------------------------------------

ellipse_df <- pca_facet_df |>
  group_by(PCA_panel, PCA_group) |>
  filter(n() >= 3) |>
  ungroup()

# --------------------------------------------------
# 7. Plot
# --------------------------------------------------

p_pca_facet_cd4 <- ggplot(
  pca_facet_df,
  aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = PCA_group, shape = Timepoint)
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = pca_facet_df |> filter(Disease == "HIV"),
    aes(group = ID),
    color = "grey80",
    alpha = 0.5,
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  stat_ellipse(
    data = ellipse_df,
    aes(group = PCA_group),
    type = "norm",
    level = 0.95,
    linewidth = 0.9,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  facet_wrap(~ PCA_panel, nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pca_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of immune responders and non-responders based on CD4 cell count",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pc1, 2), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pc2, 2), "%)"),
    color = NULL,
    shape = NULL
  ) +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p_pca_facet_cd4

# --------------------------------------------------
# 8. Save
# --------------------------------------------------

dir.create("../plots/pdf/pca", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("../plots/png/pca", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  "../plots/pdf/pca/PCA_immune_responders_CD4_faceted_ellipses.pdf",
  p_pca_facet_cd4,
  width = 14,
  height = 6
)

ggsave(
  "../plots/png/pca/PCA_immune_responders_CD4_faceted_ellipses.png",
  p_pca_facet_cd4,
  width = 14,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

## A

```{r}
input_metadata <- metadata |>
  filter(Timepoint == "Baseline",
         Subgroup != "Elite controller",
         Disease == "HIV") |>
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID)) |>
  mutate(
    Comparison = case_when(
      `CD4 cell count (baseline)` < 350 &
      `CD4 cell count (follow-up)` < 350 ~ "case",

      `CD4 cell count (baseline)` > 500 &
      `CD4 cell count (follow-up)` > 500 ~ "control",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(Comparison)) |>
  mutate(Age = ifelse(is.na(Age), `Age (baseline)`, Age))

input_data <- data_wide |>
  filter(DAid %in% input_metadata$DAid)

hd_obj <- HDAnalyzeR::hd_initialize(
  dat = input_data,
  metadata = input_metadata,
  is_wide = TRUE,
  sample_id = "DAid",
  var_name = "Feature",
  value_name = "NPX"
)

de_results <- hd_de_limma(
  dat = hd_obj,
  variable = "Comparison",
  case = "case",
  control = c("control"),
  correct = c("Age", "Sex")
) |>
  hd_plot_volcano(
    pval_lim = 0.05,
    logfc_lim = 0.5,
    top_up_prot = 20,
    top_down_prot = 20,
    title = "CD4 non-responders vs responders (baseline)",
    report_nproteins = FALSE
  )

res_cd4_baseline_immune <- de_results$de_res

p_cd4_baseline <- de_results$volcano_plot +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "significant down" = "#317EC2",
      "significant up"   = "#C03830",
      "not significant"  = "#C4C4C4"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "significant down" = "Significantly decreased",
      "significant up"   = "Significantly increased",
      "not significant"  = "Not significant"
    ),
    name = NULL
  )

p_cd4_baseline$layers[[1]]$aes_params$size   <- 3
p_cd4_baseline$layers[[1]]$aes_params$alpha  <- 0.7
p_cd4_baseline$layers[[1]]$aes_params$stroke <- 0

p_cd4_baseline
```

## Heatmaps

```{r}
# ==================================================
# 0. Libraries
# ==================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(pheatmap)
library(tibble)

# ==================================================
# 1. Targets (CD4)
# ==================================================

targets <- res_cd4_baseline_immune |>
  filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05) |>
  pull(Feature)

# ==================================================
# 2. SAFE JOIN (FIXED)
# ==================================================

combined_df <- hpa_data |>
  select(Ensembl, UniProt = Uniprot) |>
  distinct() |>
  inner_join(
    olink_uniprot |> distinct(),
    by = "UniProt",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) |>
  distinct(Ensembl, Feature, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  filter(Feature %in% targets)

# ==================================================
# 3. VASCULATURE DATA
# ==================================================

cluster_df_vasculature <- single_cell_cluster_data_raw |>
  filter(Tissue == "vasculature") |>
  rename(Ensembl = Gene) |>
  inner_join(combined_df, by = "Ensembl")

# ==================================================
# 4. MATRIX
# ==================================================

mat_vasculature <- cluster_df_vasculature |>
  select(Feature, `Cell type`, nCPM) |>
  group_by(Feature, `Cell type`) |>
  summarise(nCPM = mean(nCPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = `Cell type`, values_from = nCPM, values_fill = 0) |>
  column_to_rownames("Feature") |>
  as.matrix()

# ==================================================
# 5. CLEAN MATRIX (CRITICAL)
# ==================================================

mat_vasculature_log <- log1p(mat_vasculature)

# Remove Inf / NaN
mat_vasculature_log[!is.finite(mat_vasculature_log)] <- NA

# Remove rows with too many NA
mat_vasculature_log <- mat_vasculature_log[
  rowSums(is.na(mat_vasculature_log)) < ncol(mat_vasculature_log) * 0.5,
]

# Impute NA with row mean
mat_vasculature_log <- t(apply(mat_vasculature_log, 1, function(x) {
  x[is.na(x)] <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  x
}))

# Remove zero variance
row_sd <- apply(mat_vasculature_log, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
mat_vasculature_log <- mat_vasculature_log[row_sd > 1e-6, ]

cat("Vasculature matrix size:", dim(mat_vasculature_log), "\n")

# ==================================================
# 6. SPLIT UP / DOWN
# ==================================================

up_features <- res_cd4_baseline_immune |>
  filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05, logFC > 0) |>
  pull(Feature)

down_features <- res_cd4_baseline_immune |>
  filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05, logFC < 0) |>
  pull(Feature)

mat_up   <- mat_vasculature_log[rownames(mat_vasculature_log) %in% up_features, , drop = FALSE]
mat_down <- mat_vasculature_log[rownames(mat_vasculature_log) %in% down_features, , drop = FALSE]

# ==================================================
# 7. PLOTS
# ==================================================

dir.create("../plots/pdf/cluster", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("../plots/png/cluster", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- ALL ---
pdf("../plots/pdf/cluster/cd4_vasculature_all.pdf", width = 10, height = 12)

pheatmap(
  mat_vasculature_log,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  scale = "row",
  fontsize_row = 8,
  fontsize_col = 9,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(100),
  main = "CD4 vasculature signature"
)

dev.off()

# --- UP ---
pdf("../plots/pdf/cluster/cd4_vasculature_up.pdf", width = 10, height = 10)

pheatmap(
  mat_up,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  scale = "row",
  fontsize_row = 8,
  fontsize_col = 8,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(100)
)

dev.off()

# --- DOWN ---
if (nrow(mat_down) >= 2) {
  pdf("../plots/pdf/cluster/cd4_vasculature_down.pdf", width = 10, height = 6)

  pheatmap(
    mat_down,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    scale = "row",
    fontsize_row = 8,
    fontsize_col = 8,
    color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(100)
  )

  dev.off()
}
```

```{r}
# ==================================================
# BLOOD DATA
# ==================================================

cluster_df_blood <- single_cell_cluster_data_raw |>
  filter(Tissue == "blood") |>
  rename(Ensembl = Gene) |>
  inner_join(combined_df, by = "Ensembl")

# ==================================================
# MATRIX
# ==================================================

mat_blood <- cluster_df_blood |>
  select(Feature, `Cell type`, nCPM) |>
  group_by(Feature, `Cell type`) |>
  summarise(nCPM = mean(nCPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = `Cell type`, values_from = nCPM, values_fill = 0) |>
  column_to_rownames("Feature") |>
  as.matrix()

# ==================================================
# CLEAN MATRIX
# ==================================================

mat_blood_log <- log1p(mat_blood)

mat_blood_log[!is.finite(mat_blood_log)] <- NA

mat_blood_log <- mat_blood_log[
  rowSums(is.na(mat_blood_log)) < ncol(mat_blood_log) * 0.5,
]

mat_blood_log <- t(apply(mat_blood_log, 1, function(x) {
  x[is.na(x)] <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  x
}))

row_sd <- apply(mat_blood_log, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
mat_blood_log <- mat_blood_log[row_sd > 1e-6, ]

cat("Blood matrix size:", dim(mat_blood_log), "\n")

# ==================================================
# SPLIT
# ==================================================

mat_up   <- mat_blood_log[rownames(mat_blood_log) %in% up_features, , drop = FALSE]
mat_down <- mat_blood_log[rownames(mat_blood_log) %in% down_features, , drop = FALSE]

# ==================================================
# PLOTS
# ==================================================

# --- ALL ---
pdf("../plots/pdf/cluster/cd4_blood_all.pdf", width = 10, height = 12)

pheatmap(
  mat_blood_log,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  scale = "row",
  fontsize_row = 8,
  fontsize_col = 9,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(100),
  main = "CD4 blood signature"
)

dev.off()

# --- UP ---
pdf("../plots/pdf/cluster/cd4_blood_up.pdf", width = 10, height = 10)

pheatmap(
  mat_up,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  scale = "row",
  fontsize_row = 8,
  fontsize_col = 8,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(100)
)

dev.off()

# --- DOWN ---
if (nrow(mat_down) >= 2) {
  pdf("../plots/pdf/cluster/cd4_blood_down.pdf", width = 10, height = 6)

  pheatmap(
    mat_down,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    scale = "row",
    fontsize_row = 8,
    fontsize_col = 8,
    color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(100)
  )

  dev.off()
}
```
